name: Courageous Crew
body:
The travelers in your caravan are particularly brave.

Prerequisite: Morale 3.

Benefit: Your caravan gains a +2 bonus on all Resolve checks made against fear effects, including Resolve checks made to resist a rout (see Caravan Combat).

Special: You can gain this feat up to three times. Its effects stack.
